# Vendored frontend assets

Pinned copies of the frontend libraries, served same-origin from /static/vendor/
so a CDN outage cannot take the app down (ROADMAP stability item 2). To
upgrade: download the new pinned version from the URL pattern below, update
this manifest, and rerun scripts/build_css.sh if Tailwind changed.

tailwind.css is GENERATED by scripts/build_css.sh (tailwindcss v3.4.17
standalone) from frontend/tailwind.config.js; CI fails if it is stale.

htmx and its SSE extension were removed in plan step 5.5 (finding D20): no page
used an `hx-` attribute, and they cost 58 KB on every page.

Reveal.js is the slide decks' runtime (plan step 6.6, finding E13); the decks
rendered by pipeline/render/html_renderer.py load it from /static/vendor/reveal/,
so a deck makes no third-party request. It is pinned to the newest 5.x (the
decks were built against `reveal.js@5`); 6.x moved its files. Decks rendered
before this still name the CDN until they are re-rendered and re-seeded.
